RequiredFindings.Question: Q03
RequiredFindings.Defect: Python per-character upper() is not .NET OrdinalIgnoreCase. U+017F folds to ASCII S here, so Work + U+017F + pace is selected by Workspace although .NET ordinal case-insensitive IndexOf returns -1. U+0131 similarly produces a false match for Filter. Non-ASCII FQNs are currently admitted without restriction. A synthetic fixture using long-s FQNs still produced 59 passing verification checks.
RequiredFindings.Authority: A-8 Sec.2 explicitly promises VSTest/.NET OrdinalIgnoreCase semantics; the Coordinator order requires faithful RequiredTests reconstruction. LIFECYCLE Sec.5 requires verifiable frozen guarantees.
RequiredFindings.Correction: In the next append-only amendment, implement matching equivalent to the required .NET comparison or explicitly reject unsupported non-ASCII FQNs fail-closed. Add synthetic long-s and dotless-i regressions against the .NET oracle.

RequiredFindings.Question: Q04
RequiredFindings.Defect: The parser ignores supplied execution/outcome counters other than total, passed and failed. Changing only executed from 9 to 0 in the valid synthetic GREEN TRX leaves nine Passed rows, yet load_trx accepts it and all 59 verify() checks pass. Contradictory required source evidence is therefore silently accepted.
RequiredFindings.Authority: The Coordinator order requires fail-closed parsing; AUTOMATION_PLAN Sec.16.9 Tests requires coherent TRX evidence, and Sec.16.11 S-04 treats contradictory evidence as STOP.
RequiredFindings.Correction: In the next append-only amendment, validate supplied executed and supported outcome counters against the parsed rows, rejecting contradictions and unsupported nonzero outcome categories. Add a regression where executed=0 contradicts Passed rows.

RequiredFindings.Question: Q11
RequiredFindings.Defect: Result execution identity is never validated or deduplicated. Replacing selected result e3 with a second identical e2 result in both synthetic TRX files leaves counters, handoff totals, RED composition and GREEN/RED key comparison accepted. Six selected rows then represent only five distinct executions, while all 59 verification checks pass. Repeating records can falsely satisfy MinSelected.
RequiredFindings.Authority: A-8 Sec.3 promises fail-closed TRX verification and meaningful RequiredTests counts. AUTOMATION_PLAN Sec.16.9 Tests requires coherent selection evidence; LIFECYCLE Sec.5 rejects unverifiable guarantees and open failure paths.
RequiredFindings.Correction: In the next append-only amendment, require unambiguous result execution identities and reject duplicate execution records before tallying. Preserve legitimate distinct Theory executions. Add a synthetic duplicate-result regression with unchanged counters and matching GREEN/RED duplicates.

Limitations: Independent read-only session; the reviewer did not author the object and used no author memory or transcript.

The tempfile-based CLI self-test and regression demonstration were not rerun under the read-only policy. Their pinned results and hashes were inspected. Additional adversarial probes exercised unmodified functions entirely in memory with synthetic read/Git I/O stubs; main() was not invoked.

Real F2-T1 TRX and handoffs were not processed by the bridge. Historical counts and input hashes were checked against versioned custody and Coordinator records, without independently recomputing the real selection.
